UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly Light Theme ONLY. No dark mode toggle unless requested by user. Primary theme is clean, crisp light background (slate-50 / white).
Use Outfit for headers, Manrope for body text, and JetBrains Mono for monetary values and metrics.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, dialog triggers) have explicit data-testid attributes.
Do not use transparent background on dropdown menus, modals, or header overlays — use solid white with shadow-md or backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90.
Ensure monetary values use font-mono tabular-nums and colored indicators (green for recovered, amber for identified/pending).
Assign distinct group and domain badge colors based on leakage_domains mapping.
